define.elig: employee_category in ('Shopfloor Associate', 'Supervisory') and scheduled_shift in ('Production Shift - 01', 'Production Shift - 02', 'Production Shift - 03', 'D Production Shift 01', 'D Production Shift 03', 'Production Shift - 01 - Sat', 'Production Shift - 02 - Sat', 'Production Shift - 03 - Sat', 'Saturday Special Production Shift')
define.reached_6am: ((employee_category == 'Supervisory' and punch_out_time >= time('04:30:00')) or (employee_category == 'Shopfloor Associate' and punch_out_time >= time('05:00:00'))) and punch_out_time <= time('09:00:00')

cases.when: elig and day_name in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_6am and reached_6am

elig and day_name in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_6am and ((employee_category == 'Supervisory' and punch_out_time >= time('19:30:00')) or (employee_category == 'Shopfloor Associate' and punch_out_time >= time('20:00:00')))

elig and day_name in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_6am and ((employee_category == 'Supervisory' and punch_out_time >= time('14:30:00')) or (employee_category == 'Shopfloor Associate' and punch_out_time >= time('15:00:00')))

elig and day_name in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_6am and ((employee_category == 'Supervisory' and punch_out_time >= time('09:30:00')) or (employee_category == 'Shopfloor Associate' and punch_out_time >= time('10:00:00')))
elig and day_name in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_night and reached_6am
elig and day_name not in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_6am and reached_6am
elig and day_name not in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_2pm and reached_6am
elig and day_name not in ('Saturday', 'Sunday') and started_night and reached_6am
